configurationOwner: main commits conf; in-place registration performed by raf-s1b-scaffold under direct main instruction
prerequisites: conf/projects.json routes raf development to verified raf-develop workspace
profile node: cwd '.', executable 'node', argv ['./scripts/test-run-node.ts'], exactIds 'node-test-name', resultAdapter 'node-test-events'
isolatedHome=true and stateOrigin=true; wrapper establishes stable isolated QA HOME/state/tmp for this project/workspace/group; no working state inherited by runner
timeout and timeout-count policy come from conf/flow.json#/unitTests; no local override or new budget
do not change the selected node profile/inventory/group while the queued run performs configuration revalidation

stages.red: test-scaffold executes --phase red; main verifies target assertion diagnostics
stages.implement: same group and exact files with --phase implement
stages.qa: same group and exact files with --phase qa

regressionsAfterImplementation.note: Real process/socket acceptance stays distinct from the isolated unit-red; no live or green claim in this scaffold.
